source_text.body:
Let agents handle a week of marketing
Poster let agents post and edit content, reply on Reddit in their voice, and review analytics for a week.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
For a week, the poster let AI agents handle organic marketing work rather than ads. From the post and follow-up comment, the agents read analytics to spot what was working, wrote scripts, edited clips, scheduled posts for when the audience was online, and even replied on Reddit in the poster’s voice; the person stepped in when one comment surfaced a software bug and they fixed it.
How it went
The clearest result stated was that an agent’s Reddit reply helped uncover a bug in the poster’s software, which they then fixed. They also clarified the agents were not creating or changing ad campaigns, only posting, editing content, and reviewing analytics.
Worth knowing
The main catch is scope: this setup covered content posting, editing, scheduling, Reddit replies, and analytics review, not paid ads or campaign targeting.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
For the next week, help me with marketing for [brand/product]. Draft and edit posts for [platforms], suggest replies to relevant [Reddit] threads in my voice using these samples [paste writing samples], and summarize analytics at the end of each day. Show me every post and reply for approval before anything is published or sent.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/Agentic_Marketing/comments/1v92k0l/i_let_my_ai_agents_run_my_marketing_for_a_week
